BackstoryDef.title: siege-born
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born inside a shrinking perimeter and never once saw it grow. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to strip a beam rifle before learning to read, because among the last Rakata every child was ammunition for a war their parents were already losing.

BackstoryDef.title: vault-schooled
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the deep archives while the surface burned, taught by the finest minds of a dying people. The Rakata knew they were losing, so they poured everything they had ever learned into their children — the only vessels certain to outlast the war.

BackstoryDef.title: child of the builders
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents raised worlds — terraformers of the great Rakata age, who brought the metal down from the sky. [PAWN_nameDef] inherited their hands and their stubbornness, but grew up watching everything they built be eaten, and hardened instead of breaking.

BackstoryDef.title: line-breaker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] held the collapsing lines against a thing that wore the dead as armor. [PAWN_pronoun] fought with weapons that frightened even the Rakata who forged them, and won every battle that mattered to nobody, because the war was already lost.

BackstoryDef.title: quarantine warden
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] burned the outbreaks — settlements, harvests, friends — anywhere the enemy's flesh took root. [PAWN_pronoun] saved millions and remembers none of them, only the faces at the cordon line. [PAWN_pronoun] still wakes reaching for the igniter.

BackstoryDef.title: weapons author
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] designed the arsenal of a desperate people — weapons meant to kill something that would not stay dead. Every design was a line [PAWN_pronoun] swore never to cross, crossed. Only one line held: [PAWN_pronoun] never once shaped flesh, and never will.

BackstoryDef.title: world-keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept the great works alive while the war ate them — rerouting water tables around battlefields, holding the climate engines together with salvage and refusal. The world the Jawa scavenge is [PAWN_possessive] unfinished repair job, abandoned mid-shift.

BackstoryDef.title: long-sleep volunteer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] stepped into the casket believing the war could still be won by whoever woke [PAWN_objective]. Every hour since waking is an inventory of everything the Rakata made, ruined; everyone [PAWN_pronoun] knew, gone longer than their graves. [PAWN_pronoun] survives it, because surviving is the one thing left to be superb at.

BackstoryDef.title: taken young
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was carried off a burning Rakata evacuation column before the age of ten. What did the carrying was not describable, and where it took [PAWN_objective] had no name. [PAWN_pronoun] came back years later, alive, changed, and unable to say which of those facts is worse.

BackstoryDef.title: flesh-shaped
BackstoryDef.description: The enemy rewrote [PAWN_nameDef] strand by strand, testing what a Rakata could be made into. [PAWN_pronoun] escaped, or was discarded — the records disagree and [PAWN_pronoun] does not. What was done to [PAWN_objective] works flawlessly, and [PAWN_pronoun] would burn every gene-forge in the galaxy to be wrong about that.
